starters.title: Animal-health status register
starters.task: This starter records a dated compliance assessment and the related externally issued health certification for an animal, animal group, or agricultural facility. It stores the certification's recorded status and validity dates as separate facts. The record-health-certification-status Action records a later source assertion on the same certification while BReg history retains the earlier values. It changes only the recorded status, source-effective date and opaque source reference; the certified subject, authority, scheme, scope, assessment and validity period remain unchanged.
starters.summary: Dated animal-health assessments and externally issued certifications.

recordTypes.description: One dated assessment against stated requirements.

recordTypes.label: Health certification
recordTypes.description: Recorded facts from one externally issued certification.

actions.label: Record health certification
actions.description: Atomically record an external assessment and certification.

actions.label: Record health certification status
actions.description: Record a later status assertion supplied by the authoritative source.

starters.title: Companion animals and keepers
starters.task: This starter supports a small administrative task: record a contact-responsible person, register a companion animal with one 15-digit microchip assignment and first keeper-responsibility period, then record a later keeper handoff without losing the earlier period. The registrar supplies those facts from its external registration or handoff process. BReg records them atomically; it does not decide whether the person is an owner, verify identity or contact details, inspect an implanted chip, or establish the legal effect of a handoff.
starters.summary: Companion animals, recorded microchips and keeper-responsibility periods.

recordTypes.description: One persistently recorded companion animal.

recordTypes.description: A period of recorded keeper responsibility for one animal.
